The Company has received ₹6,25,90,500/- (Rupees Six Crore Twenty-Five Lakh Ninety Thousand Five Hundred Only), being 25% of the aggregate issue price, in accordance with Regulation 162 of the SEBI ICDR Regulations. The balance 75% amounting to ₹18,77,71,500/- (Rupees Eighteen Crore Seventy-Seven Lakh Seventy-One Thousand Five Hundred Only) shall be payable upon exercise of the Warrants in accordance with the terms of issue.
